scientific_integrity: Closed-form proof in RESULT.md. Independent stationary-generator and exact-rational symbolic checks included in verify.py, not substituted for a proof. Literature overlap was assessed at claim level; independence and publication priority remain unverified.
scientific_limitations: Exact single-battery four-state Markov model only, with independent symmetric telegraph switching and symmetric local-detailed-balance transition rates; no generic noisy drive, finite-time optimization, physical switching implementation, or device-wide fuel budget is analyzed. The slow-switch limit is one-sided. Stronger unknown telegraph-kinetic formulas could subsume the result.
title: Zero-mean telegraph affinity: an exact storage–dissipation frontier for a two-state battery
